mapper.select: SELECT msg_no, room_no, sender_email, msg_type, content, offer_price, offer_status, reg_time FROM tbl_chat_message WHERE room_no = #{roomNo} ORDER BY reg_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_chat_message (room_no, sender_email, msg_type, content, offer_price, offer_status) VALUES (#{roomNo}, #{senderEmail}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{offerPrice}, #{offerStatus})
